title: Country pack store: shared definitions
description: Draft. Shared field formats for the country pack publish record, country index and tenant pin (contracts/country-pack-store.md, ADR-0071 Proposed). Not a document type on its own.

digest.description: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters (ADR-0071 item 0). Anything else is malformed.

semver.description: Same pattern as the version in the country pack schema.

publishId.description: ULID in Crockford base32, upper case.

utcTime.description: RFC 3339 time in UTC with a Z suffix.

ref.description: Opaque non-blank reference to a record held elsewhere (evidence item, review, audit entry, step-up event).

staffSubject.description: Stable staff-realm identity subject (ADR-0047). Never an email or phone number; never written to a tenant audit.
